summary.text: Michael Caw is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 114 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Brett Mauldin for an open seat.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired R&D laboratory technician and a city commissioner in Newborn, Georgia.

paragraphs.text: Michael Caw earned a high school diploma from Wichita Heights High School and a bachelor's degree from Wichita State University in 1989, and he is retired.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is originally from Kansas, has lived in the metro Atlanta area for more than 30 years, and is a member of the Newborn Volunteer Librarians, the Newborn Tree Board and the Comprehensive Plan Update Steering Committee.
Caw advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026, receiving 4,185 votes without an opponent.

In the survey, he listed affordable healthcare, reduced tax burdens, and responsible growth and environmental stewardship as his key messages, and said he wants more state funding for students with special needs.
